_comment: ZeRO Stage 3 shards parameters, gradients, AND optimizer states across all GPUs, so no single GPU ever holds the full model. This enables training much larger models (30B+) on hardware that Stage 2 could not fit, at the cost of higher communication volume since full parameter shards must be all-gathered on demand for each layer's forward/backward pass, and typically lower throughput than Stage 2. Use Stage 2 when the model fits per-GPU and you want speed; use Stage 3 when the model itself is too large to fit without sharding parameters.
